paper.title_en: Application of Deep Neural Networks in Top-Higgs Coupling Analysis with the ATLAS Detector
paper.abstract_en: The associated production of a Higgs boson with a single top quark provides direct sensitivity to the relative phase and magnitude of the Higgs-top coupling. Due to the high similarity of the final-state signature with the dominant backgrounds and extremely small number of signal events, machine learning techniques are required to achieve sufficient signal-background separation. Results of Deep Neural Network (DNN) approaches as a cross-check method for event classification problem in the ATLAS analysis are presented in this paper.
